title: Anonymous whistleblower on crash retrieval team in northern Nevada
place_text: Northern Nevada desert (former Nevada Test Range), USA

tellings.quote: initial, he was on a crash retrieval team in the northern Nevada desert way north. Used to be called the Nevada Test Range. And about I think it was 2009, somewhere around there, he was on a team retrieving these objects.

plain: A longtime UFO disclosure campaigner, Steven Greer, relays the story of an unnamed insider who came to him. Greer says this man was on a crash retrieval team, a group sent to recover crashed objects, working far north in the Nevada desert on land once called the Nevada Test Range, and that around 2009 his team was retrieving these objects. If true, it would mean such recoveries were still happening in recent years.
